bonuses.name: Devotion
bonuses.text: Any time a Cultist is slain by a Critical Hit, the GM gains 1 Ruin.

abilities.name: Shoot and Stab
abilities.text: A Cultist takes no Multi-Action penalty on a turn where they elect to shoot their Autopistol and stab with their Knife.

options.name: Ranged Attackers
options.text: Some Cultists are better armed for long-ranged attacks instead of melee. Replace the Cultist's Autopistol and Knife with an Autogun, and their Stab and Shoot ability with For the Dark Gods!

abilities.name: For the Dark Gods
abilities.text: Whenever the Cultist rolls a 6 on the Wrath Die, the GM gains 2 Ruin instead of 1.
